name: Deathguard Simmer
summary: Deathguard Simmer is a Forsaken soldier stationed just outside Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. He sizes up newly risen Forsaken and sends them to raid the human pumpkin farm to the west, patrolled by the Scarlet Crusade, for reagents the apothecaries of Brill need.

sections.title: Guardian Outside Deathknell
sections.body: Posted just outside Deathknell, Deathguard Simmer represents the Forsaken military line holding the border between the safe haven of Deathknell and the wider perils of Tirisfal Glades. The region crawls with living humans—most notably the fanatical Scarlet Crusade—who view all undead as abominations to be purged with fire and blade. Simmer tests fledgling Forsaken by sending them west to the Solliden Farmstead, where the Scarlet Crusade patrols from its nearby tower, to steal ten pumpkins and carry them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.

faq.answer: Deathguard Simmer is a Forsaken sentry stationed just outside Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. He tests fledgling Forsaken by sending them to steal pumpkins from a human farm patrolled by the Scarlet Crusade.
He stands just outside Deathknell in southwestern Tirisfal Glades, along the road newly risen Forsaken take out of the crypts.

faq.q: What threats does Deathguard Simmer fight?
faq.answer: Simmer despises the living humans who still farm Tirisfal and the Scarlet Crusade that patrols near them. He sends fledgling Forsaken to raid the Solliden Farmstead for pumpkins, teaching those humans a lesson while supplying the apothecaries of Brill.

angles.text: Simmer offers some of the first missions directly targeting the Scarlet Crusade, marking an undead adventurer's graduation from the crypts of Deathknell into the broader defense of Lordaeron.
